attributes.name: record_name
attributes.meaning: Stable identity within a record type.

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.meaning: Logical record schema identity; may be carried outside persistent row storage.

attributes.name: modified_at
attributes.meaning: Latest modification instant used for optimistic conflict checks.

attributes.name: record_state
attributes.meaning: Lifecycle state independent from business progress status.

attributes.name: position
attributes.meaning: Ordering position for an owned child record.

attributes.name: parent_record
attributes.meaning: Owning record identity for child records.

attributes.name: parent_record_type
attributes.meaning: Owning record schema for child records.

attributes.name: parent_collection_field
attributes.meaning: Owning collection field for child records.

storage_rules: A regular persistent record type owns a table-like collection; a singleton stores one logical settings record; virtual record types delegate persistence; layout fields are not columns.
A reference field alone does not prove a physical foreign key or database cascade. Business validation and deletion behavior require the runtime contracts.
Protected secret fields may use separate encrypted storage and masked presentation. Read only presentation flags do not establish server-side authorization.
Field metadata defaults and constraints can be overridden or supplemented by runtime metadata customization and server business rules.
